name: R079-clefable-metronome-lock-on-then-no-acc-move
why: Challenge 7. The player's Clefable (389, Metronome 10 PP) calls Metronome 10 times in a row opposite Shuckle (528: Sandstorm, Dig, Flash, Double Team; Attack 10, so it cannot knock Clefable out); every call is a draw of one of the 336 callable moves (1 in 336 each). After the tenth call the script switches to Salamence (753) and plays Aerial Ace (slot 2; it never misses, so a Double Team stack cannot stall the end; luck6). Lock-On or Mind Reader called, then on the next turn a move with no accuracy roll (Roar, Whirlwind, Pain Split, Ghost Curse, Role Play, Yawn, Skill Swap, ...) takes the NO_ACC_CALC_CHECK_LOCK_ON arm. Chance per seed about 9 x 2/336 x 15/336 = 0.2%.
